sourceOccurrences.note: D9KI constructs a version for any deterministic observed subset of countably many coordinates. This stronger explicit kernel is not claimed as a theorem exported by the inspected module, and it is not an infinite adaptive-exploration theorem.

sourceOccurrences.label: Finite adaptive transcript laws
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 24, 32, 50, 79, 110, 127
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: QH7Q supplies the arbitrary-index injective sampling law. EE11 gives finite transcript weights and factorization against arbitrary measurable events on the complement. 86IX identifies adaptive answers with their fixed-string cylinder without a no-repeat hypothesis; only the subsequent product formula requires distinct queries along that string. Conditional division in 56TE requires positive transcript probability and is an expository consequence. No independence of the random queried set is inferred. Empty transcripts and distinct loop/non-loop coordinates are included. Infinite explorations and general randomized rules are not established by this source module.

sourceOccurrences.label: Source contracts and their scope
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with additional deductions identified
sourceOccurrences.note: FH29 supplies closed extension, the deterministic restriction representation, its measurability consequence and finite-family factorization for fixed disjoint blocks. No global countability or block finiteness is imposed; random queried sets and configuration-dependent witnesses do not satisfy the fixed-block hypothesis merely by being disjoint.

sourceOccurrences.label: Diagonal and block-independence associations
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected association with explicit scope distinctions
sourceOccurrences.note: 784S supplies standard Borel instances for the existing countable coordinate spaces. DYU8 bundles independence of arbitrary fixed disjoint blocks, measurable block observables and the coordinate family. It does not assert independence for adaptively selected blocks. Compiled evidence and independent fingerprint-bound review remain separate.

sourceOccurrences.label: Finite assignments and overwrite laws
sourceOccurrences.note: DL0X supplies the arbitrary-block pushforward. EE11 and FH29 supply finite assignment factorization with measurable outside events. The finite-image equality and lower bound are identified as deductions; they are not claimed as source exports. Strict interior probabilities suffice for every assignment, but a specified assignment needs only its own nonzero factors. Loops remain configuration coordinates.

sourceOccurrences.label: Relabelling, transcripts and cylinder associations
sourceOccurrences.note: 6RZ8 and VEUZ retain measurable bijections and law transport. EE11 and 56TE distinguish factorization from positive-probability conditional division. The helper restricts to arbitrary coordinate subsets; 5PAT reuses the frozen product-model assertion without editing it.
